1.label: very_easy
1.summary: Compare three shadow responses from two broad probe zones. The final evidence tag still has to land on the rendered inconsistent shadow.

natural_language_by_interaction.simplified: Click both probe-zone cards, then arm the red evidence tag and click the shadow whose response violates the scene geometry.
natural_language_by_interaction.full: Drag the light through both broad probe zones. Then drag the red evidence tag onto the shadow whose response violates the scene geometry.

2.label: easy
2.summary: Compare three objects across three separated responses. The extra probe distinguishes a causal deviation from a silhouette that only looks unusual in one view.

natural_language_by_interaction.simplified: Click all three probe-zone cards, then arm the red evidence tag and click the shadow with the inconsistent causal response.
natural_language_by_interaction.full: Drag the light through all three probe zones. Then drag the red evidence tag onto the shadow with the inconsistent causal response.

3.label: medium
3.summary: Track four analytic shadow tracks through three probes. One response is forged, while the other three must agree across the same lamp changes.

natural_language_by_interaction.simplified: Click all three probe-zone cards, compare the four recorded shadow responses, then arm and place the red evidence tag on the inconsistent shadow.
natural_language_by_interaction.full: Drag the lamp through all three probe zones, compare the four recorded shadow responses, then drag the red evidence tag onto the inconsistent shadow.

4.label: hard
4.summary: Preserves the original five-object, four-probe analytic crime scene exactly: four separated lamp responses, a 42-pixel zone, and direct physical dragging of the lamp and evidence tag.
4.natural_language: Move the light through every probe zone. Then drag the red evidence tag onto the shadow that cannot be physically true.

natural_language_by_interaction.simplified: Click all four probe-zone cards, then arm the red evidence tag and click the shadow that cannot be physically true.
natural_language_by_interaction.full: Move the light through every probe zone. Then drag the red evidence tag onto the shadow that cannot be physically true.

5.label: very_hard
5.summary: Compare six response tracks across five separated, tighter probes. The operator must retain more coupled lamp-to-shadow changes before locating the final forged polygon among a denser field.

natural_language_by_interaction.simplified: Click all five probe-zone cards, compare the six recorded shadow responses, then arm and place the red evidence tag on the physically inconsistent shadow.
natural_language_by_interaction.full: Drag the light through all five probe zones, compare the six recorded shadow responses, then drag the red evidence tag onto the physically inconsistent shadow.

simplified.summary: Click each visible probe-zone card to move the same lamp to that zone, then arm the visible red evidence tag and click inside the rendered shadow polygon.

full.summary: Drag the lamp through the visible probe zones, then physically drag the visible red evidence tag from its dock onto the rendered shadow polygon.
